MockEmbedder is bag-of-words, so this measures the store/index/ranking plumbing on lexical overlap; semantic quality is measured with the fastembed feature.

pricing.md:
# Pricing
The Starter plan costs 29 dollars per user per month, billed monthly, and includes up to 10 seats.
The Business plan costs 79 dollars per user per month and adds SSO, audit logs and priority email support.
Enterprise pricing is custom. Enterprise contracts start at 45,000 dollars per year with a minimum of 200 seats.
Annual billing gives a 20 percent discount on Starter and Business. Discounts are applied at checkout.
Nonprofits and schools receive a 50 percent education discount after verification of their status.
Refunds: customers can cancel within 30 days for a full refund. After 30 days no refunds are issued, but the subscription can be cancelled at renewal.
Overage: additional API calls above the quota are billed at 2 dollars per thousand requests.
Payment methods accepted are credit card, ACH bank transfer and wire for invoices above 10,000 dollars.
security.md:
# Security
All customer data is encrypted at rest with AES-256 and in transit with TLS 1.3.
We are SOC 2 Type II certified. The latest audit report is available under NDA from the trust portal.
Single sign-on supports SAML 2.0 and OpenID Connect with Okta, Azure AD and Google Workspace.
SCIM provisioning automatically creates and removes user accounts when people join or leave.
Data residency: customers can choose hosting regions in the EU (Frankfurt) or the US (Virginia).
Backups run every 6 hours and are retained for 35 days. Recovery point objective is 6 hours.
Penetration tests are performed twice a year by an independent firm, and results are summarised for customers.
GDPR: we sign a data processing agreement and list every subprocessor on our website.
product.txt: The dashboard shows live metrics for every pipeline, refreshed every five seconds.
Integrations include Salesforce, HubSpot, Slack, Zendesk and Snowflake out of the box.
The public REST API has a rate limit of 600 requests per minute per workspace.
Webhooks notify your systems when a pipeline fails, with automatic retries for 24 hours.
The mobile app for iOS and Android lets managers approve workflows on the go.
Custom roles let admins define granular permissions for viewers, editors and owners.
Uptime SLA is 99.9 percent for Business and 99.95 percent for Enterprise, with service credits if missed.
The workflow builder is drag-and-drop and needs no code; advanced users can add Python steps.
onboarding.md:
# Onboarding
Implementation takes two to four weeks with a dedicated onboarding engineer.
Data migration from legacy tools is included for Enterprise; Business customers get migration templates.
Training: we run three live training sessions for admins and record them for later viewing.
Support hours are 8am to 8pm Eastern, Monday to Friday. Enterprise gets 24/7 phone support.
Every Enterprise account gets a named customer success manager and quarterly business reviews.
A free trial lasts 14 days with full Business features and no credit card required.
Sandbox environments for testing are available on Enterprise at no extra cost.

bank-faq.md: Card pricing: the premium debit card costs 5 dollars per month. Refunds for card fees take 5 business days.
Security: the bank app uses fingerprint login. Encrypted messages reach support within one hour.
Support hours for the bank are 24/7 by phone. The mobile app supports iOS and Android.
Enterprise banking accounts have a dedicated relationship manager and custom pricing.
